description: EU Regional Economy, Greenhouse Gas, and Energy (EU-REGEN) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by ifo Institute; EPRI. "EU-REGEN is built to generate quantitative scenarios that represent an optimal and consistent decarbonization path for the European power system towards 2050". Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
